status: Post-hoc controls; original outcomes already known; not preregistered
design: Same ten datasets, five seeds, three saved outer folds; fixed KNN5 and selected-column preprocessing/SMOTE. No search or test-label tuning. Greedy starts with all features and applies the exact existing utility/cost deletion repair once. Saved outer-training utility is reused, not fitted on test labels.
costs: Same single synthetic cost draw per dimension as primary; no generalization over cost assignments
analysis: Ten dataset means; Resampled EHOA minus three controls for BA, cost ratio and descriptive Nogueira stability. Exact conditional signed-rank; one Holm family of nine tests. Bootstrap 20000 dataset resamples, descriptive unadjusted intervals. AllFeatures stability is degenerate (one by convention), not evidence of useful biomarkers.
timing: Utility is reused; no standalone runtime or speedup claim.
